name: OVP-Sponsorizare
author: ovpdigital

sections.description:
OVP-Sponsorizare is a WordPress plugin dedicated to Romanian nonprofit organizations for online collection of tax redirection forms and sponsorship contracts, fully compliant with Romanian tax legislation (ANAF).

Form 230 — Individual Taxpayers

  • Complete online form compliant with OPANAF 103/2025
  • Digital handwritten signature (canvas)
  • Automatic generation of official ANAF PDF
  • Automatic email with PDF attachment
  • Organization submits the form to ANAF on behalf of the taxpayer

Form D177 — Legal Entities

  • Form compliant with schema D177_A1.0.8 (SPV ANAF)
  • Generates valid XML file for submission via SPV (ANAF Private Virtual Space)
  • Multiple beneficiaries — add/remove dynamically
  • Clear instructions for qualified electronic signature and SPV submission
  • Taxpayer submits signed XML directly via SPV

Sponsorship Contract

  • Form for individuals and legal entities
  • 3 types of sponsorship: monetary, goods, services
  • Generates complete PDF with 10 chapters (including GDPR clauses)
  • Dedicated space for manual signature and stamp
  • Automatic email to sponsor with signing instructions

Admin Features

  • Dashboard with statistics: number of forms 230, 177, contracts and declared amounts
  • Fully configurable colors from admin with live preview
  • Organization data auto-filled in forms from settings
  • Responsive — works on any device
  • Server-side validation on all forms
  • WordPress nonce protection on all requests
  • Data stored securely in WordPress database

Shortcodes

  • [ovpspo_formular230] — Form 230 for individual taxpayers
  • [ovpspo_formular177] — Form D177 for legal entities
  • [ovpspo_contract_sponsorizare] — Sponsorship contract

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ovp-sponsorizare/, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to OVP-Sponsorizare → Settings and fill in your organization details.
  4. Create pages and add the shortcodes: [ovpspo_formular230], [ovpspo_formular177], [ovpspo_contract_sponsorizare].
  5. Configure the email address where forms should be received.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin compliant with current legislation?

Yes. Forms comply with OPANAF 103/2025. The XML schema for D177 is D177_A1.0.8 issued by ANAF.

Does the organization need to submit Form 177 on behalf of the taxpayer?

No. Form D177 is submitted by the taxpayer themselves (the legal entity) in SPV with a qualified electronic signature. The plugin generates the valid XML that the taxpayer downloads, signs, and uploads to SPV.

Does it work on multiple sites?

Yes. The plugin is multi-site ready. Organization data is configured in Settings and automatically populated in all generated documents.

Can I customize the form colors?

Yes. From OVP-Sponsorizare → Settings → Organization you can configure 5 colors (header, accent, sections, button, text) with live preview.

Is user data saved?

Yes. All data is saved in the WordPress database. You can view and download PDFs/XMLs from the admin panel.

What PHP extensions are required?

PHP 7.4 or newer. For the official ANAF 230 PDF, the imagick or gd PHP extension is required (both are standard on most hosting providers).

2.1.6

  • Added: Romanian language support (ro_RO) — plugin now ships with translation files
  • Added: load_plugin_textdomain() for proper i18n support
  • Compatibility: Tested and confirmed compatible with WordPress 7.1.2

2.1.5

  • Fix: All shortcodes now use the ovpspo_ prefix to comply with WordPress.org naming requirements
  • Note: Update your pages — replace [formular230] → [ovpspo_formular230], [formular177] → [ovpspo_formular177], [contract_sponsorizare] → [ovpspo_contract_sponsorizare]

2.1.4

  • Fix: Removed all K_PATH_* and K_BLANK_IMAGE defines from TCPDF wrapper classes — these are now handled automatically by TCPDF’s own autoconfig
  • Fix: Removed unprefixed shortcode backward-compatibility aliases — only ovpspo_* prefixed shortcodes are now registered
  • Fix: AJAX action names updated to use full ovpspo_ prefix throughout
  • Fix: Admin submenu page slugs updated to ovpspo-* prefix for full WordPress.org compliance
  • Improvement: Full Plugin Check compliance — zero errors

2.1.3

  • Fix: Custom colors (primary, accent, section, button, text) now applied correctly on all three forms (230, 177, Contract)
  • Fix: Button hover state no longer reverts to default WordPress blue
  • Fix: Checkbox rendering — replaced Unicode character with pure CSS checkmark for cross-browser compatibility
  • Improvement: All emoji replaced with Dashicons for better theme compatibility
  • Improvement: TCPDF library now bundled directly inside the plugin — no separate installation required
  • Improvement: Event delegation implemented for full Elementor page builder compatibility
  • Improvement: Plugin Check compliance improvements — reduced warnings

2.1.2

  • Added: Sponsorship Contract (Contract de Sponsorizare) for individuals and legal entities — 3 contract types
  • Added: Dedicated admin panel for contracts with PDF download and management
  • Added: Detailed address fields for organization in Settings (street, city, county, postal code)
  • Added: Fields for legal representative name, position, bank, and association register number
  • Added: Admin email notification with contract PDF attached
  • Improved: D177 taxpayer confirmation email now includes detailed SPV signing instructions
  • Fix: “Headers already sent” PHP warning on admin record deletion
  • Fix: Double arrow appearing on contract form dropdown selects

2.1.1

  • Fix: TCPDF class conflict resolved — added class_alias() to avoid collisions with other plugins loading TCPDF
  • Fix: Section III (organization data) now correctly pre-filled in the ANAF official PDF overlay
  • Fix: CIF (fiscal identification code) placement on Form 230 PDF corrected — white overlay covers pre-drawn boxes, text centered above
  • Fix: Organization name shown in PDF instead of legal representative name
  • Fix: Canvas signature lazy initialization — resolves timing issues in Elementor and other page builders
  • Fix: Form submit handler now uses event delegation to work reliably inside Elementor widgets

2.1.0

  • Added: Contract Sponsorizare module foundation (admin infrastructure, DB table, PDF class)
  • Added: Settings tabs reorganized — General, Adresă, Contact, Email, Culori
  • Improved: Settings page UX — live color preview updated in real time
  • Improved: CSS architecture refactored — all selectors migrated from ID (#bf230-wrap) to class (.bf230-wrap) for multiple-instance support
  • Fix: CSS not loading when shortcode used inside Elementor (removed has_shortcode() check — assets loaded unconditionally)
  • Fix: JS localized variable name unified to OVPSPO230 across all files

2.0.0

  • Added: Form D177 — complete XML generation for SPV submission (schema D177_A1.0.8)
  • Added: Support for multiple beneficiary organizations in Form 177
  • Added: Admin dashboard with submission statistics and informational cards
  • Added: Separate admin sections for Form 230 and Form 177 submissions
  • Added: Fully configurable brand colors with live preview (primary, accent, button, text, sections)
  • Added: Organization data from Settings pre-filled automatically in PDF forms
  • Renamed: Plugin renamed from “Formular 230” to “OVP-Sponsorizare” to reflect expanded functionality
  • Improved: Completely redesigned responsive front-end layout
  • Improved: Settings reorganized with tabbed navigation
  • Fix: Form 177 XML output — corrected namespace and encoding for SPV D177_A1.0.8 schema
  • Fix: Dashboard statistics count now excludes deleted records
  • Fix: Duplicate define() calls for OVPSPO_VERSION and OVPSPO_PATH removed from main plugin file
  • Security: Added ABSPATH guard to all 45 PHP files in bundled TCPDF library

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Form 230 (online form for 3.5% income tax redirection)
  • Front-end form with taxpayer identification and address fields
  • Admin panel for viewing and managing Form 230 submissions
  • CSV export of submissions
  • GDPR consent checkbox and data processing agreement
  • Form validation — CNP format (13 digits), email, required fields
  • Official ANAF Form 230 PDF generated via coordinate overlay on the authentic ANAF template
  • Handwritten signature capture on HTML canvas — embedded in generated PDF
  • Redirection period selection (1 year / 2 years)
  • Email notification to admin and confirmation email to taxpayer with completed ANAF PDF attached
  • Data saved to custom database table
